input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

transcript.final_response:
The 3 most frequent words in `/data/poem.txt` are below. I lowercased the text and ignored punctuation.

```
the 8
on 3
cat 2
```

Third place is a tie at 2 only if other words also appear twice. Checking the top 8 counts, "cat" is the only word with 2, so the ranking is unambiguous.
tool_calls: cat /data/poem.txt | tr -cs "[:alpha:]'" '\n' | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -3 | awk '{print $2, $1}'
cat /data/poem.txt | tr -cs "[:alpha:]'" '\n' | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -8
